subject: [PATCH v5 6/7] mm: use BIT() for change_protection() flags

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Applied his Reviewed-by tag without any objections or concerns.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series aims to standardize the use of BIT() for expressing protection flags in the mm module, replacing open-coded shifts. The goal is to improve code readability and maintainability by using a consistent macro.
